rust_summary: a plugin channel message to one player's client on any channel outside `horizon:` (`native_send_custom_payload_to_player`).
doc_summary: `native_send_custom_payload_to_player(player, channel, data)` sends a `ClientboundCustomPayloadPacket` on any `namespace:path` channel outside `horizon:` (at most 1 MiB) to one player's client, a vanilla one included, at the tick's end, from any server hook, as Bukkit's `Player.sendPluginMessage`. Bundles need "hooks": @API:send_custom_payload_to_player@.
